insert into position_snapshot ( trace_id, entry_trace_id, exchange_code, symbol, side, position_quantity, entry_price, unrealized_pnl, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{entryTraceId}, #{exchangeCode}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{positionQuantity}, #{entryPrice}, #{unrealizedPnl}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )
mapper.update: update position_snapshot set trace_id = #{traceId}, entry_trace_id = #{entryTraceId}, exchange_code = #{exchangeCode}, symbol = #{symbol}, side = #{side}, position_quantity = #{positionQuantity}, entry_price = #{entryPrice}, unrealized_pnl = #{unrealizedPnl}, created_at = coalesce(#{createdAt}, created_at) where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, trace_id as traceId, entry_trace_id as entryTraceId, exchange_code as exchangeCode, symbol, side, position_quantity as positionQuantity, entry_price as entryPrice, unrealized_pnl as unrealizedPnl, created_at as createdAt from position_snapshot where exchange_code = #{exchangeCode} and symbol = #{symbol} and case lower(side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(side) end = lower(#{side}) order by created_at desc, id desc limit 1

select ps.id, ps.trace_id as traceId, ps.entry_trace_id as entryTraceId, ps.exchange_code as exchangeCode, ps.symbol, case lower(ps.side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(ps.side) end as side, ps.position_quantity as positionQuantity, ps.entry_price as entryPrice, ps.unrealized_pnl as unrealizedPnl from position_snapshot ps inner join ( select max(id) as latestId from position_snapshot group by exchange_code, symbol, case lower(side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(side) end ) latest on latest.latestId = ps.id order by ps.created_at desc, ps.id desc
